svg.aria-label: Animated diagram of six real loops in LUX and the links Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite cut in the full run. Places: two records called Barenton, each part of the other, both links cut; Baarle, a village in Belgium and the Netherlands, tied to Baarle-Hertog and Baarle-Nassau, three of four links cut; two Cambridgeshire and two Cambridge records, three of five links cut, leaving each Cambridge inside a Cambridgeshire. Concepts: Violinists and Fiddlers, each narrower than the other, one link cut; Handbags, Bags and Bagging, two cut, keeping Handbags under Bags; Correlation, Least squares and Structural equation modeling, two cut. Across the whole run the model cut both links in 2,003 of 2,786 place pairs (72%) and 55 of 258 concept pairs (21%).

g.text: Place loops: one place entered twice, a village in two countries, a county inside its own town.
Concept loops: near-synonyms, terms that are only related, and a word with two meanings.
The full run’s verdicts: links it cut in red, links it kept in green.
Across all pairs, the model cut both links in 72% of place pairs, but only 21% of concept pairs.
Real records and links from LUX. Arrows point from the smaller place, or narrower term, to its stated parent. Short codes tell the two Barentons apart.
